purpose: Define the presentation and governed-action architecture for the ABC Roofing & Remodeling synthetic operating demonstration.

hierarchy.law: Short executive entry only: Somak's ask → what was built → enter ABC Roofing → Thursday decisions.
NOTICE. Company-wide exception-first summary across Tampa, Orlando and Jacksonville. Surface material state, flags, bottlenecks and priority jobs; do not duplicate branch/job detail.
INVESTIGATE. Three equivalent full-screen branch pages: Tampa, Orlando, Jacksonville. Selecting a branch consumes the page. Same anatomy, independent synthetic state.
KNOW. Show workflow, workload, bottlenecks, governance flags, priority jobs and changes since prior cycle.
ACT. Only governed actions derived from a visible operational condition: Notify, Instruct, Delegate, Set Next Governance Expectation.
UNDERSTAND. Drill into job records, evidence, financials, files, production readiness and closeout using Evan-derived capability.
JUSTIFY. Determine what supplied evidence establishes and what progression is permitted.
Record issue, disposition, action, owner/recipient, instruction, due point, expected evidence/state and creation timestamp. The receipt becomes input to the next governance cycle.

governedActions.boundary: Synthetic/demo notification receipt for Thursday; no external message is sent.
Document a management instruction tied to a governed issue.
Assign a bounded task/owner/due point tied to the issue.
Define the evidence/state required at the next governance check and when it is expected.

actionLaw: No generic task or communications suite. Every action must originate from an identified operational condition and create a receipt that can be evaluated in a later governance cycle.

syntheticData.requirement: Dataset must include healthy progression, aging work, missing evidence, correspondence conflicts, explicit blocks and QC holds. All identities and incidents are fictional.
syntheticData.seededScenarioLaw: Branch scenarios demonstrate different management conditions but must never imply those conditions exist in the real cities or any real company.

protectedAssets: Evan V4 financial/closeout calculations and regression
thursdayBoundary: Action architecture may be fully interactive with synthetic receipts, but external email, messaging, CRM and task-service integrations are out of scope unless separately authorized after the meeting.
rebuildOrder: Build ABC Roofing Bridge aggregation from dataset.
Build full-screen three-branch carousel front faces.
Build bounded flip-to-action backs and synthetic action receipts.
Bind job drill-down to Evan-derived Job Stage capability.
Compress LBS collaboration page to four executive sections and link into Bridge.
